The connection point between the nozzle and the water stream is indistinct and 'melty', lacking the high-pressure turbulence expected from fire monitors.

The surfaces of the boat are overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the complex micro-textures, rivets, weld seams, or weathering typical of a working steel vessel. Details like railings merge slightly into the background.
The boat in the background appears geometrically inconsistent, with the hull shape warping slightly and details becoming nonsensical blobs rather than distinct structures.
